sources.supports: moveSection validates the section ID, sends the payload as the JSON body and resolves with no value whatever TestRail returns; the driver documents the endpoint as TestRail 6.5.2 or later and recommends a follow-up getSection for the new position.

MoveSectionPayloadSchema makes parent_id and after_id each optional and nullable: null is an explicit move to the root or the top, omission leaves that axis unchanged, and the null-versus-omitted distinction must survive serialization. Values are plain numbers; TestRail validates them. It permits additional properties.
move_section/{section_id} requires TestRail 6.5.2 or later; parent_id may be null to move to the root and must be in the same project and suite, after_id may be null to move to the top.

input_policy.notes: The driver's payload schema permits additional properties; the adapter closes it. A suite_id is the likely mistake, since TestRail only moves within a suite, and is reported rather than forwarded.

outer_result.notes: The driver discards any body TestRail returns and resolves with no value; the wrapper reports data: null. Newer TestRail versions return the moved section, older ones nothing, so a caller that needs the new position reads the section afterwards.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Reject a body field the driver's schema does not declare, which the driver itself would pass through unchecked.
Reject a call without a body key rather than inventing one. An explicitly empty body is the caller's choice and is sent, changing neither axis.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The validated number is passed positionally and appears verbatim in the path.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

parameters.semantics: A number moves the section under that parent; null moves it to the root; omission leaves the parent unchanged. Null and omission are distinct on the wire. The driver's number is kept as is; TestRail decides whether the parent exists and is not a child of the moved section.

wire.encoding: JSON number or explicit JSON null in the request body; absent when omitted.

requirements.description: Preserve the value at driver argument 1 under the parent_id key.
Accept a representative parent section ID.
Send an explicit null to move the section to the root rather than dropping it.
Reject a numeric string before driver invocation rather than coercing it.
Omit the field entirely when the caller did not supply it, leaving the parent unchanged.

parameters.semantics: A number places the section after that sibling; null places it at the top of its container; omission leaves the position unchanged. Null and omission are distinct on the wire.

wire.encoding: JSON number or explicit JSON null in the request body; absent when omitted.

requirements.description: Preserve the value at driver argument 1 under the after_id key.
Accept a representative sibling section ID.
Send an explicit null to move the section to the top rather than dropping it.
Reject a numeric string before driver invocation rather than coercing it.
Omit the field entirely when the caller did not supply it, leaving the position unchanged.
